items.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jan, my wife, who we’ll talk a lot about later on – she’s very important in everything I do

ctx.x: I’ve had this desire to – they call it show business, and I had this desire to get more involved in the business end of entertainment. So we formed this company called Ivory Pyramid Productions. We leased some space near the Loop, near downtown Chicago. We had a major studio A, studio B. We had offices. We were up and running for business and made some major connections with Columbia Records and a couple other companies. But I – this is the one time I did not have the time. I’m in and out of town. I thought I…

very important in everything I do – has great natural business savvy, but had little experience in the entertainment music business. But business is business. She did her best to help keep it afloat, but it didn’t maintain itself. So we were forced to let it go.
